source: CardInsider extraction pipeline (v3.1.1 baseline) + redemption_rules transform v1
_note: Declares seed/card_details.json in the manifest so the app downloads it. The file has existed on dev since 2026-08-27 and was never reachable in production: the manifest listed only cards.json and merchants.json, so SeedSyncService never fetched it and every benefits, eligibility, redemption, FAQ and similar-cards block in the app resolved to nothing. NO card, rule or rate changes in this commit - cards.json and merchants.json are byte-identical to 5.1.38, so no rule_name moves and no user's cap progress is touched.
